briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Momentum Builds: Michigan Sales Cross $17B as National Psychedelics and Rescheduling Push Forward
briefs.top: Michigan's legal market just topped $17 billion in lifetime sales and a gubernatorial hopeful is now campaigning on killing the 24% wholesale tax, giving operators real reasons for optimism even as regulators crack down hard on bad actors. Nationally, Compass Pathways' psilocybin program is racing toward an FDA decision and Alabama just dropped its last-ditch opposition to federal cannabis rescheduling, clearing another obstacle on the road to Schedule III.

local.text: Michigan cannabis sales cross $17 billion lifetime
local.text_full: Michigan cannabis sales cross $17 billion lifetime — August alone generated roughly $259 million, pushing cumulative adult-use and medical sales above $17 billion and total state tax revenue past $2.66 billion since legalization.
